<p class="section-kicker">THE GUIDING QUESTION</p>

## One question, at different scales

My interests began with space and guidance, navigation, and control. They then moved steadily toward the models beneath the controllers: first rigid bodies, then flexible structures, and finally the computational methods needed to make those models useful.

Physical AI is the next horizon. It raises a natural extension of the same question: how might simulation, learned representations, and control come together for complex multibody systems?

> How do we model a physical system well enough to understand, simulate, and control it?

This blog is a record of working through that question from first principles—one model, derivation, and experiment at a time.
